verdict.rationale: Claude Code is itself an agent, so this story would normally not apply. However, first-party docs explicitly document `claude mcp serve`, which runs Claude Code as a stdio MCP server that other applications can connect to, so the axis applies and the capability is delivered. The evidence is a single doc passage, and the many client-side MCP items (claude mcp add, connecting to Notion/Jira) are not credited here. missing for 10: details on which tools or capabilities the server exposes, any transport beyond stdio (e.g. HTTP/remote endpoint), independent or hands-on corroboration of the server mode

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You can use Claude Code itself as an MCP server that other applications can connect to: claude mcp serve (Start Claude as a stdio MCP server).
